conviction_note: The release carries new Q3 numbers plus a guidance decision. H1 revenue plus consensus Q3 leaves Q4 needing about +14% growth to reach the bottom of the EUR 680-730m revenue guide, so a cut or narrowing is likely. Analysts (Inderes 667) and a stock down 27% since the CEO's October buys already expect much of that. The open question is whether the EBITDA range of 145-175 holds. abs_move is 12 because this name's real print-day moves were -23.4/-17.1/-4.0/+0.9/+2.5/-17.7 and the equity is about a quarter of EV. p_up 44 is a weak lean down: a likely guide cut, no securitisation news and a new CFO, partly offset by peer beats and the CEO's buying. Findings sum -2.6 against a scaled -1.44: same sign, and the scaled number is smaller because p_up stays near 50.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue near consensus EUR 169m (Inderes 165) and adj. EBITDA near 33.0, against a soft Q3'25 base (organic -4%, political ad spend absent). Slight downside risk on EBITDA because of one-offs and Verve lagging its peers.

Revenue guide likely cut or narrowed to the low end or below (Q4 would need about +14% YoY). EBITDA guide is the swing line: held at the low end is relief, cut below 145 is another leg down. A new CFO's first report raises the chance of a reset.
Verve customarily gives first-half-of-Q4 trading. Likely positive on US midterm political spend and peer strength, but unproven.

Unknown. The securitisation expansion promised in August 'within weeks' has not been announced. Signing would be positive; silence or a smaller facility negative. Net leverage was promised to fall in H2, and a EUR 10m deferred purchase price was due in October.
Q3 compliance with the bond's 4.50x maintenance test (reported leverage 4.1x at Q2). Consensus Q3 EBITDA improves the LTM figure, so a breach is a tail risk, not the base case.

findings.finding: The revenue guide is arithmetically out of reach. H1 reported revenue of EUR 289.5m plus Bloomberg consensus Q3 of EUR 169m means Q4 must reach about EUR 221m, +14% on Q4'25's EUR 193.8m, for even the EUR 680m low end. The acquisitions (Captify and Acardo, Sept 2025) are fully in the base and organic growth ran 3.5% in Q2, so a revenue cut or narrowing to below the low end is the likely guidance outcome. The EBITDA range (Q4 needs about 53.6m against 48.3m in Q4'25) is the swing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance cut on 14 Aug 2025: -23.4% the next session. Guidance bands narrowed at the Q3 2025 report on 18 Nov 2025: -17.1%. Guide reaffirmed but organic growth missed on 27 Aug 2026: -17.7%. The guide line has moved this stock 17-23% each time, always down.
findings.original_quote: Vores omsætningsestimat på EUR 667 mio. ligger under intervallet, og vores estimat for justeret EBITDA på EUR 149 mio. ligger i den lave ende. (Inderes, 17.11.2026: 'Our revenue estimate of EUR 667m is below the range, and our adjusted EBITDA estimate of EUR 149m is at the low end.')
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Inderes already sits below the revenue range and the stock is down 27% since 22 Oct and 40% since the Q2 eve. The preview still expects the company to REITERATE the guide, so the sell side's base case is reiteration. If a cut were fully priced, the preview would model one and the stock would have stopped falling into the print; it fell another 5% in the last five sessions. The EBITDA leg is not priced either way.
findings.independence: Q4'25 base and FY25 figures come from the issuer's 26 Jan 2026 release (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bf380afe4b938200cd6fdf161239bb48f&lang=en&src=listed). The consensus comes from the Inderes/Bloomberg table (https://www.inderes.dk/analyst-comments/verve-q326-preview-forste-test-af-den-lovede-h2-acceleration). The arithmetic rests on two documents.

findings.finding: The securitisation expansion that management said in August would be signed 'within the next few weeks' has not been announced three months later. The existing EUR 100m programme was fully drawn at end-Q2. The EUR 500m+50m 2025/2029 FRN printed 82 on Frankfurt on 2026-11-18, down from a ~99 quote. Its terms carry a quarterly maintenance test of NIBD/EBITDA <= 4.50x, with exceptional add-backs capped at 10% of EBITDA, against reported leverage of 4.1x at Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cash flow has been the line the stock punished. Q3 2025 operating cash flow fell 91% and the stock dropped 17.1% on the day (with the guide narrowing). No clean isolated financing reaction exists on record.
findings.original_quote: Securitiseringsprogrammet var fuldt udnyttet i forhold til loftet på EUR 100 mio. ved udgangen af Q2, og ledelsen oplyste, at dokumentationen for en ”markant udvidelse” var i den afsluttende fase. ('The securitisation programme was fully used against its EUR 100m cap at end-Q2, and management said documentation for a "significant expansion" was in its final stage.') Bond terms: 'The Maintenance Test is met if the ratio of Net Interest Bearing Debt to EBITDA does not exceed 4.50:1.00' (https://investors.verve.com/media/akolx1rq/verve-group-se-bond-prospectus-final-locked-version.pdf)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the bond at 82 is the credit market saying this, and the equity has fallen with it. What is unpriced is the release's own answer: facility size, tenor, pricing, Q3 cash flow and the compliance figure. Asked what the money buys, the facility funds receivables on a seasonally larger H2, which is ordinary working capital. Its delay therefore reads as lender reluctance rather than a ramp. Signing would flip the sign, hence the wide range. Covenant breach is a tail, not the base case: consensus Q3 EBITDA (~30 reported vs 21.8 in Q3'25) lowers LTM leverage.
findings.independence: The bond price is a different source: TradingView FWB:SE2384842, last bar 82 on 2026-11-18 (https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/FWB-SE2384842/). This is a single thin Frankfurt print, snippet-grade. A Danish Inderes forum post of 16.11.2026 notes the bond has fallen during the year.

findings.finding: Peer read-through for Q3/Q4 open-internet ad spend is positive. PubMatic posted Q3 2026 revenue +17.1% YoY ($79.6m vs $76.1m consensus) and Magnite beat with political ads near 3x its forecast. Verve's own Q3 2025 release blamed a 'substantial reduction in political ad spending' for the soft base it now laps.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 prelim, which showed an organic rebound: -4.0% (an intraday release, so the move is mixed). Q1 2026 'solid organic growth': +2.5%. Good reported-quarter lines have earned only small gains here.
findings.why_not_priced: Verve fell through the peers' beats (Magnite 4 Nov, PubMatic ~10 Nov), so the read-through has not reached this price. Had it, VER would have tracked the peers' rallies. This is a proxy, though: Inderes expects Verve to lag both peer groups and Verve's organic growth trailed peers in Q2, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Magnite Q3 2026 with political ads near 3x forecast (https://ppc.land/magnite-net-income-gains-70-to-34m-as-political-ads-near-3x-forecast/). Verve Q3 2025 release on the political base (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b5f99c4a3cc90beb3610064bc39962476&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: CEO Remco Westermann (via Bodhivas GmbH) bought roughly 360k shares (~EUR 0.4m) on 19-23 Oct 2026. Q3 had closed by then, and the window ended just before the 30-day MAR closed period. Under MAR he could not trade while holding inside information, so as of 23 Oct management did not consider a guidance change disclosable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to insider buying for this name. The stock fell 27% after these purchases.
findings.why_not_priced: The purchases are public, but the stock has since fallen 27% to SEK 8.64, below his SEK 11.6-11.8 cost. So the market has priced a deterioration the CEO did not see at the time, or priced past the information. It is an inference about Q3 rather than a number, and it is small relative to his holding, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: No other sourced indication of Q3 trading since August, other than management's Q2 comment that budgets were returning in Q3 (cited in https://www.inderes.dk/analyst-comments/verve-q326-preview-forste-test-af-den-lovede-h2-acceleration).

findings.finding: The CFO was replaced with immediate effect on 3 Nov 2026, three weeks before the report, after the CRO left following about six months. Q3 is the new CFO's first report, which raises the chance of a conservative guidance reset. The stock fell 7% on 3 Nov before the 17:16 announcement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior CFO change on record for this name in the window searched.
findings.original_quote: salgsdirektørens (Chief Revenue Officer) fratræden efter ca. seks måneder tilføjer en vis eksekveringsrisiko ('the Chief Revenue Officer's departure after about six months adds some execution risk'), Inderes 17.11.2026
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock fell 7% on 3 Nov and has kept sliding since. What remains is the inference that a new CFO resets the guide rather than defending it, which no preview models; Inderes expects reiteration. It overlaps the guidance finding's direction but rests on a different fact (the personnel change, not the arithmetic).

baseline_tension: The findings lean negative, the same way as the -25% 20-day run-up and the falling bond, and against priced_lean_pct (+1.24, a mean-reversion term). That agreement is why each negative is shrunk and p_up sits at 44, not lower: much of the guide-cut risk is visibly in the price.
language_note: The Swedish filings are line-for-line translations of the English EQS releases (e.g. 'Fortsatt tillväxt under Q2 2026 ... helårsprognosen bekräftas') and add nothing.
No Swedish-language press coverage (Di/Placera/DN) of Verve was found for Oct-Nov 2026; the local press is silent on this name.

The Danish-language Inderes forum (not Swedish) carried retail colour the English sources did not: a 16.11 post that Verve's bond had fallen sharply this year, and a 03.11 post that the -7% day looked like someone knew what was coming. The Danish preview itself is a translation of the English one.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance findings 11 of 17 on sign, median 9% on a change): guidance-arithmetic finding raised from -2.0 to -2.5.
'Understatement is the systematic error' / size the move on what is new: abs_move_pct raised from 11 to 12, in line with the name's real print moves (median about 10.5%, three of six at 17% or more).
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': peer read-through cut from +1.0 to +0.8, because Verve lagged peers in Q2 and the sell side expects it to lag again.
'Your own caveat has to reach the number': CFO-reset finding is an inference largely in the 3 Nov price, cut from -0.8 to -0.6.

'Financing is a question' and 'cash can outweigh a guide': securitisation/bond finding kept at -1.0 with a range that includes a positive outcome if the facility is signed; covenant breach labelled a tail risk.
